newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer ahead of CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer ahead of CPI data.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended firmer around C$1.3880 (US$0.7204) on Monday from Friday's close at C$1.3905 (US$0.7191) * Traders expecting quiet overnight session ahead of Canada consumer price data for July due on Tuesday * Overnight range of C$1.3860-C$1.3900 * Canada manufacturing shipments fell 0.1 percent in June. compared to 0.2 percent drop in May
The July CPI data is also expected to show Canada's annual inflation rate remains below two percent.
Technical Data analyst David Ebata said inflation for the most part is benign given the massive restructuring the Canadian economy has undergone.

"What may be more relevant is the potential threat of deflation should the economy start to turn sour. Certainly for those who are looking for a near term rate hike, consideration has to be given to this possibility," Ebata said in a report.
In other economic news, Canadian manufacturing shipments fell 0.1 percent in June. versus a 0.2 percent drop in May.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a 0.1 percent rise in manufacturing shipments for June.
On the crosses, the Canada dollar rose to 84.97 Japanese yen from 84.59 on Friday and climbed to 1.3217 marks from Friday's 1.3079 marks.
